behavior: public lifecycle stages cover input admission and receipt, context assembly and compaction, model request completion failure and retry, tool before and result, run finish and task finish
startup validation freezes extension key implementation version configuration version order kind failure mode and stages
ordered lifecycle manifests persist on foreground background delegated and peer-triggered runs
recovery rejects a changed lifecycle manifest
planning context compaction retry and observation compose independently in deterministic order
policy decisions are stage-scoped and can only append planning guidance lower context limits or narrow retry
observers cannot return decisions and always continue after failure
fail-closed handlers are rejected for committed input model tool and terminal stages
extension errors and panics expose only a stable lifecycle failure code
every handler receives an owned event copy and cannot mutate persisted model input tool arguments or receipts
tool before follows current authorization confirmation schema and availability checks
tool result events follow durable exact receipt storage
model request follows durable attempt admission and completion or retry events follow durable attempt state
module hosts contribute lifecycle extensions before workers start
runtime hot installation removal and persistent observer outbox delivery remain outside version one
